items.summary: The page index entry now records `p`, the kinds that have a stack with room left (written on every page commit). `mayTake` takes the stack's kind and the mode. In "merge" mode it needs a partial stack of that kind; in "fill" mode it also takes a free slot. A full page of full stacks of the item is therefore skipped without restoring its structure. Index entries without `p` (from 1.8.8 or older) still work: their page is loaded once, the result is remembered by snapshot id, and later passes skip it. stash_bp is 1.8.9 and sync-diag was run. PACKS.md is updated. After the review, the full-page BDS scenario now counts page snapshot restores (storage entity spawns not caused by Spawned, or entityLoad) against routing saves (cause Spawned). It asserts at most 1 restore per save; 88cc198 makes about 2 per save. A run on the old code now fails, so the scenario proves F3 itself and does not just check that items are kept.
items.proof: Unit tests in tools/stash-pages.test.mjs count structure loads. (1) A full page of 24 x 64 dirt is restored 0 times over 5 routed pickups; base 88cc198 restores it every pass. (2) A full page with one partial dirt stack is read once and topped up. (3) A pre-1.8.9 index entry is read once, then skipped. Tests 1-3 fail against base code. At HEAD the file passes 151/0. The BDS scenario stash-autostore-full-page.js now asserts restores <= saves, which fails on 88cc198 (see bdsPending). The ms/tick numbers are still owed.

items.summary: liveTotals (the hotbar, cursor and worn-gear totals) runs only when the viewed page has 4 or fewer free slots (LIVE_MARGIN). The review found a stuck case: a burst could take the page from 5 or more free slots to 1 or none within one look (a broken chest, mob loot, or several pickups between two 25 s quiet scans). That look had no earlier totals and only took a baseline, so a full page and hotbar could stay unrouted for good. The fix: snapshots now also record `empty`. When the look before had more than LIVE_MARGIN free slots and no totals, every new stack on the page counts as arrived and is routed as usual (one transaction, nothing lost). The only side effect is that a stack the player moved from the hotbar onto the page within that same look also goes to another of their pages. PACKS.md replaces the wrong 'stays on the page / within half a second' caveat with this behavior.
items.proof: New unit test "F13: a burst that fills a roomy page at once is still routed, not left stuck on a full page": six 64-dirt stacks land in one look on a page with 6 free slots. Before 8973edb it fails with '0 free'. After, at least 2 slots are free again, the dirt that left is on page 1, and all 384 dirt are kept exactly once. These still pass: "F13: auto-store looks at a page with room..." (0 worn-gear reads against 18 on base) and "F13: near a full page ... a move still isn't" (a hotbar-to-page move near a full page is not routed). The whole file passes 151/0.

items.summary: storedCount no longer reads every old `stash:page:<n>` property on each realm:stash_count_ask. Pages with a native snapshot are skipped. A page found holding an old property is remembered per player, and only pages not yet known are checked. playerLeave clears legacyCache and storedCache. The review's stale-cache finding is not real here, so nothing changed. Nothing removes a player's `stash:page:<n>` while they are online. /realm:diag forget clears World dynamic properties only: diag-shared.js wraps World.prototype get/set/ids/clear and never touches Player properties. stash_bp never writes or deletes these properties. No pack calls player.clearDynamicProperties. A page's first native write adds its ref, which changes the signature.

Both checks fail on base 88cc198. The whole file passes 151/0. decisions: F3: The room data is a list of the kinds that have a stack with room left (`p`), keyed like `k`. Matching by kind can only over-report room, so a page is never wrongly skipped; at worst one load is wasted.
F3: For old index entries without `p`, what was learned is kept in memory by snapshot id rather than written to the index outside a commit. Snapshot ids name immutable contents and are never reused.
F3: In merge mode a page is skipped when its room list is known and has no partial stack of the kind; the fill pass still loads it if there is a free slot.

F13: I used a free-slot margin (totals only at 4 or fewer free slots) rather than an inventory-event dirty flag. While mining, every look follows a change, so a flag saves nothing, and skipping the quiet scan would remove its safety net.

Review finding 1 (F13 burst, real): when the look before had more than LIVE_MARGIN free slots and so no carried totals, and the page is now down to 1 or 0 free slots, the new stacks on the page are routed as pickups. Reason: functionality comes before UX. Leaving them would keep a full page and hotbar stuck, and the worst misread only moves the player's own stack to another of their pages, with no loss. I rejected a bigger LIVE_MARGIN (no finite margin covers a broken chest) and an event-time baseline (afterEvents arrive after a same-tick burst has landed, and cursor and worn gear have no events).

Review finding 2 (scenario, real): the full-page scenario now counts storage-entity restores against routing saves through entitySpawn causes (with entityLoad as a fallback) and asserts restores <= saves, so it fails on 88cc198. I could not use a structureManager hook because the scenario runs in another script context. The scenario fails closed if the events don't show up, and the raw counts are logged.

Review finding 3 (F49 stale legacyCache, not real, no change): nothing removes a `stash:page:<n>` player property while the player is online. /realm:diag forget clears only World dynamic properties (diag-shared wraps World.prototype), stash_bp never writes or deletes them, and no pack clears player properties. Re-checking presence on each ask would re-read the property (up to 30 KB), which is the cost F49 removed.
Version: stash_bp stays at 1.8.9 (already bumped in this branch and unreleased; origin/master is 1.8.7), so the review fixes need no further bump; diag.js already carries 1.8.9.
O19: Not done here. It is expedition_bp's cart code.
Line endings: pages.js and stash-pages.test.mjs have mixed CRLF/LF. New lines take their neighbors' endings.

The full-page scenario's restore count depends on how BDS reports entitySpawn causes for structure-loaded entities and on reading typeId of an entity that was removed in the same call. If the counts log as 0, the scenario fails closed and the classification needs adjusting from the logged numbers.
tsc and npm run check were not run (code-only mode). The new JSDoc (snapshot `empty`, the optional `was`, PageIndex `p`) needs tsc to confirm.

F13 burst fallback: a hotbar-to-page move of stacks within the same look that takes a roomy page (5 or more free) to 1 or 0 free is routed to another page like a pickup. This is documented in PACKS.md, and nothing is lost.
Other workstreams that touch stash_bp pages.js or page-store.js will conflict in mayTake, autoStore, the snapshots type or storedCount, and in the version (1.8.9).

decisions: Finding 1 (anchor from another dimension), REAL, fixed in f62327e. The anchor is dropped in three places: in confirmPlacement and in both click handlers before they build, by the playerDimensionChange after-event (stable), and by the preview loop, whose dimension check now runs before its hidden-preview and held-item skips. Reason: the confirm path is the only guard that also covers the one-tick race and Disable preview mode; the event clears the anchor at once so it is never shown or kept.

When a click finds an anchor from another dimension, the handlers drop it and then treat the click as the first click of a new shape in the current dimension. Reason: the player's click starts something sensible instead of being swallowed.

decisions: F12: settle lives in its own module (scripts/settle.js), so the unit test runs the real code. On a failed save it re-reads the store and returns only what is gone. Reason: a write can land the value but fail on the index.
F12: when the save fails, the dishes stay owed until the next join. Reason: no duplicate and no loss; the owed store is the single source of truth.
F11: only Chest Finder's own find:cfg or find:idx:0 marks a world as existing. Reason: in a bundle, other packs write on world load before Chest Finder decides.
F23: an ambiguous (null) prefix leaves the key unowned. Reason: giving it to the first pack that touches it lets that pack's forget delete another pack's data.
F10: champion scaling is kept. Reason: owner answer.

Review finding 1 (find-mode-bundle leftover answer) is real. Fixed in ecfc418: forms are detected through t.forms(p) and closed by the scenario, never through a queued answer. Reason: the harness's answer queue is a per-player FIFO that only a form consumes.
Review finding 2 (find-index leftover answer) is real. Fixed in 162fc9c the same way. Reason: the unused answer silently closed the next form.

Review finding 3 (F45 unmeasured; getAllPlayers every 5 ticks) is real in that no measurement was taken. F45 stays done-needs-bds, with the perf-soak at 10 and 40 players as a must-pass bdsPending item. Reason: code-only mode (TIMING_SOAK_RUNNING) all session.

F45 getAllPlayers: I tried a one-list-per-second bucket and reverted it. New joiners waited up to 2 s for their first draw, which broke existing 'drawn within the first second' tests. Per CLAUDE.md I won't add a second unmeasured optimization. If the 40-player soak shows stats_bp over 0.15 ms, the next step is buckets refreshed on playerSpawn/playerLeave. Reason: 3 extra getAllPlayers calls a second are small next to the bar writes and score reads already removed.

Review finding 4 (tie rule mismatch) is real. Fixed in c68498d: rankedInfo also gives each name its shared place, which placeOf, My stats and the leaderboard numbers use. The leaderboard's 'your position below the top N' still uses the list index to decide whether to add the extra line. Reason: one tie rule everywhere a player sees a rank.
Review finding 5 (no NEWS entry) is real, but the task forbids editing NEWS.md. The player-facing lines are in newsLines for the integrator.
newsLines: Kitchen: a finished dish waiting for you is never handed over twice, even if the world fails to save at that moment.

Stats: the ticker above your hotbar is lighter on the server. A number that keeps changing (like distance walked) now updates every 2 seconds instead of every second.
Stats: players with the same score now share a place on the ticker, in My stats and on the leaderboards.

items.summary: Wrote every missing native acceptance scenario. O27: claims-animals.js covers feeding and shearing in a claim, a positive control outside the claim, the owner's own use, protectAnimals off, the visitors' door switch (doors only, a chest stays closed) and the operators' audit list with its sorts. O29: mail-moderation.js covers the per-sender unread cap, blocking and unblocking, and the operators' purge by sender, including a de-op during the confirmation. party-moderation.js covers the leader's mute, the one-message-a-second cooldown, and pruning of long-gone solo parties after a restart (seeded through the probe). O30: crowns-limit.js covers the 5,000 daily limit, a refused payment that moves nothing, a new UTC day through the saved day total, and the audit ledger order and UTC dates. After review, it now waits for both players' daily login bonus messages (JOIN_DELAY is 200 ticks) before it measures balances. O31: nick-reserved.js covers reserved words in any spacing, listed gamertags, online operators' gamertags and a player's own gamertag. Owed migrations: owed-legacy-consumers.js covers relics, fishing, bounty, guilds and town, each with its real legacy shape, a too-long id and a rejected record. It checks the migration, the index, that unknown fields are kept, payment exactly once and the state after a restart. All of this runs through the harness-only hook tools/test-bds/hooks/owed-probe.mjs. None of it has run on BDS yet: TIMING_SOAK_RUNNING was there the whole session.

decisions: Review finding 1 (elite-invalid stress 1 never reaches convert): real, fixed in 14f8b09. The mob is removed by a harness probe inside elite_bp (hooks/elite-remove.mjs), not from a scenario entitySpawn listener as the reviewer suggested. The order in which separate script contexts get an after-event is not defined, so a scenario listener could run before the pack's handler and again test only the handler guard. Inside one context, a subscription made on the first tick runs after main.js's own handler. The scenario checks that all 20 were removed while still valid.

Also on finding 1: convert()'s isValid guard predates 6f85410 (6f85410 added the spawn-handler and upkeep guards). So stress 1b's fail-before proof is a copy with convert's guard taken out, and the 6f85410^ run proves stress 1a (the handler guard), which is kept. Both are in bdsPending.
